name: swanlab-accelerator-sample-quality-reports
instr:
Swanlab cannot currently expose immutable accelerator reports with vendor identity, metric observations, and overall quality. Add vendor-neutral reconciliation that classifies every expected metric from deterministic evidence, rejects duplicates, and returns one observation per expected key in supplied order.

Keep existing vendor parsing and compatible scalar results while providing complete accounting for AMD, Cambricon, Ascend, Moore Threads, MetaX, Hygon, Iluvatar, and Kunlunxin. Every AcceleratorProtocol implementation must provide a quality report without replacing its collect call. For each configured device, AMD must distinguish missing sysfs measurements, unreadable values, and successful Windows fallback values. Cambricon must independently reconcile utilization, memory, temperature, and power for every configured MLU. Ascend must preserve flattened device identity and classify every physical NPU and chip query independently. `SampleQuality` is a Enum.

Each completed monitor cycle must publish one report per configured collector in collector order and emit every collected scalar. A collector failure must produce a failed vendor report without suppressing successful reports or scalars. Out-of-order completion must not change vendor or observation order. An Ascend chip failure stays isolated while another vendor's scalars succeed. Malformed Cambricon memory must not degrade valid utilization or temperature.
